caseName: Minnesota v. First of Omaha Service Corp.
caseNameFull: Minnesota v. First of Omaha Service Corp. and Marquette National Bank of Minneapolis v. First of Omaha Service Corp.

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Minn. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. In addition to the questions presented by the petitions, the parties are directed to brief and argue jurisdictional issue as to whether the petitions were timely filed.
